Name: Easy Fishing v2.0
Author: mmanlapat
Description:
[size=4]Made fishing easier.[/size]
[color=#cccccc]This mod reduces the amount of movement the fish does while fishing. The higher the percent, the easier fishing is.[/color]

[size=3][b]Notes:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][color=#6fa8dc]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+[/color].[/size][/b]
[*]Please [b][color=#6fa8dc]ENDORSE[/color][/b] or [b][url=http://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=24NAGUZNEE4R8]Donate[/url][/b] if you like the mod. :D
[/list]
[b][size=3]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/size] 1.2+. (If you don't own the game, please consider buying it [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/]here[/url])
[/list]
[b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*]Open mod file and choose a file version. [color=#cccccc](If there are any)[/color]
[*]Extract the contents into [color=#6fa8dc][size=2][font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Content[/font][/size][/color]. [color=#cccccc](Updating) Remove\Replace any previous version of the mod.[/color]
[*]Run the game.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Files:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Easy Fishing 25% - Makes fishing 25% more easier than vanilla fishing.
[*]Easy Fishing 50% - Makes fishing 50% more easier than vanilla fishing.
[*]Easy Fishing 75% - Makes fishing 75% more easier than vanilla fishing.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Latest Changes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]June 06, 2018[/b] (2.0) - [i]Added a version for Stardew Valley Beta.[/i]
[/list]

[size=1]*** Feel free to comment and report issues. ***[/size]
